This is not a production fence or provisioning script. The trusted fixture launcher can be bypassed, actual credentials and the complete NodeODM HTTP contract are unqualified, and host capability provisioning, direct published ports, Docker lifecycle/restart ownership, established-stream drain and a consistent backup remain unresolved. The read-only preflight does not enforce a boundary and its output-size check occurs after capture. Do not deploy or use this draft to authorize cutover.
